title: Transfer of truncated-octahedron references into the T-055 proof lane
question: Which archived truncated-octahedron and BCC calculations can be reused in the current T-055 proof lane, and how can a finite truncated-octahedron candidate be compared fairly with the cubic baseline?
method: Classify R-169 geometry as an exact metric-regular BCC Voronoi fixture, an affine-combinatorial family, and a separate extracted-statistical interpretation.
Reuse the R-169 v1.1 field-center-Voronoi construction and its positive-above-zero result as a finite regression and negative control, not as a universal rejection.
Carry R-169 v1.2--v1.4 commensurability, covariance/mean, native Reading-H and common-Bohr firewalls into the candidate manifest.
Retain the legacy BZ interval, cubic-harmonic and anisotropy package as method-only input pending current-owner revalidation, and retain Math194/Math400 as hostile controls.
Define a matched cube-versus-truncated-octahedron finite comparison with common parent functional, reference, volume, degrees of freedom, boundary, cutoff, finite parts and error budget.
finding: The archived material is directly useful as geometry fixtures, owner/commensurability firewalls, a finite positive-above-empty counterexample, and adversarial competitor tests. It contains no surviving evidence that a truncated-octahedron candidate beats physical empty space. The proof lane can therefore use the truncated-octahedron in parallel with the cubic baseline without reviving BCC selection, provided all comparisons are matched and geometry-dependent results remain scoped.
decision_reason: The transfer converts scattered legacy material into a bounded T-055 protocol: exact inputs, parallel controls, promotion criteria and stop rules. It supplies a reusable finite candidate route but makes no claim or tier change.
boundary: T0 strategy and finite-candidate routing only. No truncated-octahedron vacuum, BCC selection, Reading-H-to-P1 bridge, physical-empty sign, continuum/thermodynamic limit, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, QFT or Yang--Mills result follows.
next_action: Reproduce the R-169 geometry and field-center fixtures, then run a matched cube-versus-truncated-octahedron finite parent calculation including the empty/reference branch, stationarity, transverse Hessian, finite gap, propagation cone and anisotropy. Revalidate the BZ/anisotropy method under the current parent before using it as evidence.
no_overclaim: Legacy positive BCC wording remains retired. A finite truncated-octahedron pass is a candidate/control result until uniform margins and limit control are established.

qft_interface.closed: The T-055 proof lane now has explicit reusable geometry inputs, negative controls, matched-comparison fields and finite promotion/stop rules.
qft_interface.open: The actual parent-functional energy, physical-empty sign, full-tangent stationarity, transverse stability, finite-size uniformity, continuum/thermodynamic limits, C6, Sector A, Pre-A and QFT reconstruction.
qft_interface.route: R-169 geometry and legacy controls -> matched cube/TO finite comparison -> uniform sign/stability and limit tests -> only then C6/Pre-A reassessment.

formal_integration.lean: not applicable; reference transfer and protocol only

adversarial_review.check: Math194/Math400 refutation and the retired BCC claim remain hostile controls; no positive wording is imported.
Metric-regular, affine-combinatorial and extracted-statistical cells are not interchangeable after seeing data.
Candidate ranking against other ordered states is not substituted for the physical-empty/reference sign.
Finite cube/TO agreement or a finite gap does not establish volume, regulator or continuum uniformity.
The transfer changes no parent functional, claim tier or C6 premise and keeps T-055 as the candidate owner.
